verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is an agent, but it ships its own first-party hosted MCP server, so the server axis applies. The docs give a concrete `claude mcp add` command and an HTTP-transport URL usable by any MCP client, and describe OAuth with a Perplexity account, thread-based sessions, progress notifications and approval/input relay tools. Independent runtime probes confirm the live endpoint returns a structured OAuth challenge and serves RFC 9728 discovery metadata.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
Any MCP client that supports the HTTP transport can connect using the server URL
The Computer MCP Server authenticates users via OAuth 2.0 using your Perplexity account. No API key is required.
live proof the hosted Perplexity Computer MCP server exists and enforces OAuth with a Perplexity account (no API key), exactly as the docs claim.
